text:
jordan-pm: quick sync. AcmeHealth wants an "autotune" pilot: per-route recs for batching/caching/quant + eval alerts. Keep model weights unchanged. Goal: p99 <=150ms, 25-30% token savings. can we scope an MVP?
maya-eng: we can deliver advice-only MVP fast. runtime suggestions + sim-estimated impact. auto-apply needs more gates.
simon-ml: agree. recommender outputs batch_size, quant_level, cache_ttl, and expected tradeoff curve. we'll run sims on historical traffic. need golden prompts for eval.
linh-ux: UX must be frictionless: card with Suggested Profile, Expected Impact, Confidence, and an "Apply to Canary" button. explain modal with sim charts.
ara-ops: ops requirements: mandatory canary traffic split, rollback hook, tenant kill-switch, and audit log entries for every change. no KMS secrets in logs.
carl-cs: AcmeHealth requested eval-triggered alerts on their golden set. frequency?
simon-ml: propose nightly batch eval + immediate smoke check after any apply (sample 100 requests). thresholds: >3% quality delta or >5% semantic drift => auto-rollback + alert.
jordan-pm: launch checklist draft: 1) sim-backed recommendations on staging 2) Canary apply to 5% traffic + smoke eval 3) UI + weekly digest opt-in 4) ops runbook + SLOs 5) customer docs + rollback SLA
maya-eng: telemetry needed: per-route token counts, latency histograms, seq length distribution, cache hits. recommender needs these to simulate batch impact.
linh-ux: prototype mock this week for AcmeHealth signoff? small clickable flow would help.
simon-ml: I'll produce sample recs from the sim harness and a mock API.
ara-ops: nightly cadence acceptable for MVP. ensure alerts route to oncall and CS.
carl-cs: include a one-pager "what changes" and opt-out steps. AcmeHealth legal wants rollback timeline.
jordan-pm: estimate: sim harness 2w, telemetry + ingest 2w, decision engine 1.5w, canary plumbing 1w, UI/docs 1w = ~7.5w with parallel work. aim for pilot kickoff in 8-9 weeks.
maya-eng: risks: quant affects outputs subtlely; gate auto-apply on concordance. batching can increase p99 for tail; include latency contours in UI.
jordan-pm: next actions: simon - branch + sample recs; maya - telemetry schema; linh - mock; ara - ops runbook; carl - customer docs. I'll arrange AcmeHealth kickoff. syncing Thu. :thumbsup:
